queer_characters.name: Gad Beck

queer_characters.name: Pierre Seel

queer_characters.name: Albrecht Becker
queer_characters.notes: German Christian photographer arrested for homosexuality; shares his testimony as a gay survivor.

queer_characters.name: Annette Eick
queer_characters.notes: Jewish lesbian who escaped to England; provides survivor testimony in the documentary.

queer_characters.name: Karl Gorath
